chart.tapeHint: Buy − sell is aggressive futures flow in each candle. CVD range 24h is 5-minute bars. 7d, 30d, and 90d fold stored minutes into 30-minute, 2-hour, and 4-hour bars and draw the running sum. CVD also resets at 00:00 UTC and at the current 4-hour open. Book shading is resting size for the candles on screen. A view longer than 30 minutes uses stored minute ladders. Color behind the candles is estimated liquidation intensity for the selected range. A combined cell is colored only when Binance, Bybit, and OKX each have their own price and open interest. Open levels stay until price trades through them. The still-open gap also resets at 00:00 UTC, at the current 4-hour open, and at a clicked candle. When stored minutes cover the candles, buy and sell sit inside each candle. Otherwise the right edge is buy versus sell at each price, and the bars beside it are estimated liquidation pockets. The lower strip is crowd long percent versus top traders. Binance and OKX draw both. Bybit draws the account crowd only. Open interest, funding, the crowd, and liquidation notional follow the candles: 5 minutes through 24 hours, 30 minutes through 7 days, 2 hours through 30 days, and 4 hours after that, up to 90 days. A missing step is left out. Open interest and the top-versus-crowd gap also reset at 00:00 UTC and at the current 4-hour open. Liquidation bars are short notional minus long notional in that same step. The leverage mix is a model. The point of control and the 70% value area are aggressive-print prices for the candles on screen. Arrows mark a poke through a prior high or low. Squares mark a print size that repeats in the last 5 minutes. Informational only.

openLevels.caption: Levels stay until a later candle trades through them. The line underneath is open long size minus open short size. That gap also resets at 00:00 UTC, at the current 4-hour open, and at a clicked candle. The first sample places open interest already on the books. A level that closes because open interest fell was not liquidated. A traded-through level is not put back.

Combined adds a column only when Binance, Bybit, and OKX were all recorded. A quiet recorded column is a real zero. Informational only — not financial advice.
